_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.

url_research_pass.method: Per-country web research. A URL was accepted only when the page was actually retrieved and its content confirmed the publication. Publisher homepages, Wikipedia, news, aggregators and mirrors were rejected. Confirmations are stored on each node as _url_evidence.

url_unreachable_or_not_published.title: Tourism arrivals and tourism revenue statistics
url_unreachable_or_not_published.finding: Still not found. TurkStat's Turizm Istatistikleri quarterly bulletins do exist (bulletin IDs such as /tr/press/54157 and /Bulten/Index?p=Turizm-Istatistikleri-... are indexed), but every path on veriportali.tuik.gov.tr - and data.tuik.gov.tr, which 302-redirects there - returns the same 'JavaScript Gerekli / JavaScript Required' stub, including /tr/press/<id>, /en/press/<id>, /Bulten/Index, /Bulten/DownloadIstatistikselTablo and even static-looking paths like /pdf/kilavuz.pdf. It is a catch-all SPA with no server-rendered fallback. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism is unreachable from here on every hostname tried (ktb.gov.tr, www.ktb.gov.tr, yigm.ktb.gov.tr, istatistik.ktb.gov.tr, kulturturizm.gov.tr all fail with connect timeout / DNS). tga.gov.tr (Tourism Promotion and Development Agency) renders but its Aylik Raporlar page exposes no report titles or download links without JavaScript. The only TurkStat document I could actually retrieve that contains tourism data is the compendium https://www.tuik.gov.tr/media/announcements/istatistiklerle_turkiye_2021.pdf, whose table of contents lists section 47 'Turizm / Tourism' - it is a genuine TurkStat publication but it is a general yearbook from 2021, not the Tourism Statistics product, so I am not recording it as the URL.
url_unreachable_or_not_published.second_opinion: Grok searched independently and also came up empty, hitting the same blockers.

url_partial_match.title: Ankara Gross Regional Domestic Product
url_partial_match.caveat: Retrieved and read. TurkStat PDF 'Main Revisions Studies on Gross Domestic Product by Provinces - Explanatory Note', published by TurkStat's Directorate of National Accounts Department, Presidency of Regional Accounts Group, dated 11 December 2025. It is the official TurkStat document for the Il Bazinda Gayrisafi Yurt Ici Hasila series: it sets out data sources and calculation methods for provincial GDP at current prices and chain-linked volume indices, the 2025 main revision, ESA-2010 alignment, and states the regional GDP series have been extended back to 2000 across all 81 provinces (Annex 1 gives the full IBBS/NUTS classification). CAVEAT, stated plainly: this is the series-level methodology/revision note, not a table of Ankara's GRDP figures. The province-level data pages and the dated bulletin 'Il Bazinda Gayrisafi Yurt Ici Hasila, 2024' (id 53930) sit only on veriportali.tuik.gov.tr, which serves the JavaScript-required stub on every path, so no Ankara-specific page could be confirmed. A Turkish-language twin of this document was also verified at .../A%C3%A7%C4%B1klama_dok%C3%BCman%C4%B1_BHG_TR2025.pdf.
url_partial_match.second_opinion: Grok independently reached the same URL, so this is the best link that exists — not a shortcut. Treat the series-level match as final unless the publisher adds a per-node page.
